settings.title: AI provider
settings.subtitle: Connect your own AI provider key to power Flowtali AI for your organization.
settings.loadErrorHint: Check your connection and try again.
settings.encryptionNote: Flowtali encrypts your API key at rest and uses it only for {org}'s AI requests. No one — including Flowtali staff — can read it, and it's never shared outside your organization.
settings.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this AI provider? Flowtali AI will stop working until you connect a key again.
settings.validateNote: We validate the key with the provider before saving it — nothing is stored if it's rejected.
settings.saveError: Couldn't save the key. Please try again.

steps: Sign in to the Anthropic Console and open Settings → API keys.
Click “Create Key”, give it a name like “Flowtali”, and copy it — it starts with sk-ant-.
Make sure your Anthropic account has billing/credits enabled, then paste the key above.
Sign in to the OpenAI Platform and open the API keys page.
Click “Create new secret key”, name it “Flowtali”, and copy it — it starts with sk-. You can only see it once.
Ensure your OpenAI account has billing set up, then paste the key above.
Sign in to Google AI Studio and open “Get API key”.
Click “Create API key”, choose or create a Google Cloud project, and copy the key.

agent.title: Flowtali AI
agent.subtitle: Your organization's AI assistant
agent.setupBody: Flowtali AI runs on your organization's own provider key — Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini. Add one to start chatting. Your key is encrypted and used only for your organization.
agent.setupAdminNote: Ask an organization admin to add an AI provider key under Settings → AI.
agent.notConfiguredBody: Flowtali AI runs on your own provider key. Add one under Settings → AI to start chatting.
agent.emptyBody: Ask me to draft a letter, polish an invoice description, or summarize your billing — in any of your languages.
suggestions: Draft a polite payment reminder to a client whose invoice is 2 weeks overdue.
Write a professional thank-you note for a client who just paid.
Turn “logo stuff and 3 revisions” into a clean invoice line-item description.
Draft a project engagement letter for a new branding client.
agent.error: Something went wrong reaching your AI provider. Please try again.
agent.disclaimer: Flowtali AI can make mistakes. Review important content before sending.
